Gift Cards - Dice Dungeon
Gift Cards

Give a game night. A Dice Dungeon gift card gets the whole private room in Töölö for one group, or a Game Master-led adventure. Pick a digital card by email or a printed card by post. Valid for 12 months.
How does it work?
1. Pick digital or posted, then pick the card. At checkout you can add the recipient’s name and a greeting, and we put them on the card.
2. Pay by card, Apple Pay or Klarna (Stripe).
3. The digital card arrives by email within a few minutes, as a PDF to print and an image to send on WhatsApp. Posted cards ship within 1-2 working days, with the digital copy sent right away.
4. The recipient books at dicedungeon.fi/booking, picks the booking on the card and enters the code at checkout. The price goes to zero.
What can it be used for?

Each card covers one booking: the room for 6 or 12 hours (any day), or a 3 or 5 hour adventure with a Game Master. Adventures are booked at least 5 days ahead, and we confirm the date once the Game Master is set.
Terms
Valid for 12 months from purchase. The code works once and can’t be exchanged for cash. Bookings follow the normal calendar. We post within Europe only. Questions: booking@talecraftgames.com.

FAQ - Dice Dungeon
Usein kysyttyä / FAQ
Lyhyet vastaukset yleisimpiin kysymyksiin Dice Dungeonista. Short answers to the most common questions about Dice Dungeon, the private tabletop RPG and board game room in Töölö, Helsinki.
Mikä Dice Dungeon on? / What is Dice Dungeon?

Dice Dungeon on yksityinen pöytäroolipeli- ja lautapelihuone Töölössä, Helsingissä. Huone vuokrataan kokonaan omalle porukalle: käsintehty pelipöytä, kohtauksittain vaihtuvat valot ja äänet yhdellä napilla, lounge taukoja varten ja yli 50 lautapeliä. Halutessanne mukaan saa pelinjohtajan, joka vetää Dungeons & Dragons -seikkailun.

Dice Dungeon is a private tabletop RPG and board game room in Töölö, Helsinki. You rent the whole room for your own group: a handcrafted gaming table, scene lighting and sound that change with one tap, a lounge for breaks and a library of 50+ board games. A Game Master can be booked to run a Dungeons & Dragons adventure.
Missä Dice Dungeon sijaitsee? / Where is it?
Osoite on Caloniuksenkatu 9 D 65, 00100 Helsinki, Töölössä. Julkisilla pääsee helposti, ja lähimmät raitiovaunupysäkit ovat parin minuutin kävelymatkan päässä.
The address is Caloniuksenkatu 9 D 65, 00100 Helsinki, in the Töölö district. It is easy to reach by public transport; the nearest tram stops are a couple of minutes away on foot.
Kuinka monta henkeä huoneeseen mahtuu? / How many people fit?
Huone on mitoitettu 8 hengelle, 10 toimii hyvin ja 12 on ehdoton maksimi. Pelinjohtajan vetämissä peleissä on enintään 7 pelaajaa, jotta kaikki pääsevät ääneen.
The room is ideal for 8 people, 10 works fine and 12 is the absolute maximum. Game Master-led sessions take up to 7 players so everyone gets a turn in the story.
Mitä se maksaa? / What does it cost?

Huoneen vuokra on 200 € / 6 h tai 300 € / 12 h koko porukalle. Arkipäiväpeli: maanantaista torstaihin 6 tunnin huone maksaa 120 € mihin aikaan tahansa. Pelinjohtajan vetämä Half Shot (3 h) maksaa 450 € ja One Shot (5 h) 600 €, huone sisältyy hintaan. Yritysten tiimi-ilta (3 h) maksaa 450 € + alv ja tiimipäivä (5 h) 650 € + alv, molemmat laskutetaan yritykseltä. Pidemmät kampanjat hinnoitellaan tarjouksen mukaan.

Room rental is 200 € for 6 hours or 300 € for 12 hours for the whole group. Monday to Thursday any 6-hour room booking is 120 € (Arkipäiväpeli). A Game Master-led Half Shot (3 h) is 450 € and a One Shot (5 h) 600 €, room included. The company team evening (3 h) is 450 € + VAT and the team day (5 h) 650 € + VAT, both invoiced. Longer campaigns are quoted individually.
Pitääkö osata pelata D&D:tä? / Do I need D&D experience?

Ei. Pelinjohtaja hoitaa säännöt, hahmot ja tarinan, ja suurin osa ryhmistä on ensikertalaisia. Ennen peliä pelinjohtaja on yhteydessä ja kysyy toiveista: fantasiaa vai kauhua, kuinka moni on pelannut aiemmin, millä kielellä pelataan.

No. The Game Master handles the rules, characters and story, and most groups are complete beginners. Before the session the Game Master gets in touch to ask about preferences: fantasy or horror, how many have played before, which language to play in.
Millä kielillä pelataan? / Which languages?
Pelinjohtajan vetämät pelit onnistuvat suomeksi, englanniksi ja ruotsiksi.
Game Master-led sessions are available in Finnish, English and Swedish.
Voiko omat eväät ja juomat tuoda? / Can we bring food and drinks?
Kyllä. Omat eväät ja juomat ovat tervetulleita, ja huoneessa on tilaa tarjoiluille. Siivotkaa jälkenne lähtiessä.
Yes. Your own snacks and drinks are welcome and there is space for them in the room. Please tidy up before you leave.
Mitä pelejä on tarjolla? / What games are there?
Hyllyssä on yli 50 lautapeliä kevyistä bilepeleistä pitkiin strategiapeleihin, ja omat pelit saa tuoda. Pöytä on suunniteltu sekä lautapeleille että roolipeleille.
The shelf holds 50+ board games, from light party games to long strategy games, and you can bring your own. The table is designed for both board games and tabletop RPGs.
Miten varaus toimii? / How does booking work?

Huone varataan ja maksetaan verkossa osoitteessa dicedungeon.fi/booking, ja vahvistus tulee heti. Pelinjohtajavaraukset vahvistetaan, kun pelinjohtajan aikataulu on tarkistettu. Yritykset voivat myös pyytää tarjouksen ja laskun.

You book and pay for the room online at dicedungeon.fi/booking and get an instant confirmation. Game Master bookings are confirmed once the Game Master’s schedule is checked. Companies can also ask for a quote and an invoice.
Mitkä ovat aukioloajat? / What are the opening hours?
Dice Dungeon on varattavissa joka päivä klo 10–22. Varauksen tulee alkaa ja päättyä näiden aikojen sisällä.
Dice Dungeon can be booked every day from 10:00 to 22:00. A booking has to start and end within those hours.
Sopiiko Dice Dungeon pikkujouluihin tai tiimipäivään? / Is it good for company events?

Kyllä. Tiimi-ilta on 3 tunnin ja tiimipäivä 5 tunnin pelinjohtajan vetämä seikkailu, joka räätälöidään tiimille, enintään 7 pelaajaa, 450 € + alv tai 650 € + alv, lasku yritykselle. Toimii pikkujouluina, tyky-päivänä tai pienen tiimin virkistyspäivänä. Isommille porukoille huoneen voi vuokrata lautapeli-iltaa varten.

Yes. The team evening (3 h) and team day (5 h) are Game Master-led adventures tailored to the team, up to 7 players, 450 € + VAT or 650 € + VAT, invoiced to the company. It works as a pikkujoulut party, a wellbeing day or a small-team retreat. Larger groups can rent the room for a board game night.
Miten pääsen sisään? / How do I get in?
Pelinjohtajan vetämissä peleissä pelinjohtaja ottaa ryhmän vastaan ja on paikalla koko session ajan. Huonevarauksissa soitatte ovikelloa ja saatte avaimen isännältä.
For Game Master sessions the Game Master welcomes the group and stays for the whole session. For room-only bookings you ring the doorbell and get the key from the host.

Talecraft Team
Christoffer Linder
Founder / Maker / Storyteller

I’m the creator of Talecraft – born from a deep love for tabletop gaming and a desire to offer something different. What started as a personal refuge during my recovery journey has grown into a full-time mission: to create spaces and tools that bring people together through games, storytelling, and shared imagination.

At Talecraft, I build immersive gaming environments, curate and 3D print top-tier miniatures and terrain, and work with skilled artisans to furnish the perfect setup for unforgettable sessions. I also write and publish indie games, organize events, and collaborate with professional Dungeon Masters to run unforgettable experiences.
Whether you’re booking a session at Dice Dungeon, picking out minis from the store, or diving into one of our digital games, you’re experiencing the heart of what Talecraft was built to be.
Tom Saxman
[Game Master / Swe / Eng / Fin]

Tom is a Helsinki-based screenwriter and super geek with over a decade’s worth of experience running tabletop role-playing games. He specializes in story-driven games, and enjoys enticing, shocking, and scaring new players with games and genres they might have never tried before. Creating and growing worlds together with his players is what makes his DM-brain tick; it is a known fact that including YOUR character backstories into the grand narrative makes the game richer, more immersive, and usually much, much, funnier.
Being a geek, Tom has also played numerous official “known IP games” (see list below) and will set your adventure in one of your favourite fictional worlds if you want him to.
Known games:
D&D 5e (2014), D&D 5e (2024), Lord of the Rings Roleplaying 5e; One Ring; Call of Cthulhu (7e); Star Wars Roleplaying Game (FFG); FATE; Alien RPG (1st Edition); Fiasco; Shadowrun (6e).
Chris Olsen
[Game Master / Eng / Fin]

Chris is an American archaeologist turned social worker living in Tuusula with over a decade’s worth of experience running and playing a variety of tabletop role-playing games (TTRPG’s). He likes to incorporate his background in archaeology when he can to enhance his games as well as mythologies, folktales and ancient languages. His true specialty lies in immersive storytelling, detailed worlds and puns. Many, many puns. He loves to run games in unique settings and with out-there themes. As a father of two and years of teaching experience, all ages are welcome to his table.
Known Games

: D&D 5E (2014 and 2024 ruleset with third party settings such as: Scavenger, Inferno, Kisarta, The Island of Sina Una, etc.); Gaslands; Death in Space; Mörk Borg, Lamentations of the Flame Princess; One-page RPG’s by Grant Howitt; Powered by the Apocalypse (such as Monster of the Week, Escape from Dino Island, Nahual); RISUS; Viking Death Squad; Fiasco; Kingdoms

The booking holder is financially responsible for damage caused intentionally or through negligence by themselves or their guests.
Talecraft will seek to resolve any damage situation reasonably and proportionately. The customer is responsible for documented costs resulting from negligence or misuse.

3. Bookings & Payment
Bookings are confirmed only after full payment has been received.
Dice Dungeon is reserved exclusively for your group during your booking time.
4. Cancellations & Refunds
Cancellations made
48 hours or more
before the booking start time are eligible for a full refund.
Cancellations made less than 48 hours before the booking are non-refundable.
No-shows are non-refundable.
Rescheduling may be possible if requested at least 48 hours in advance and subject to availability.
If Talecraft must cancel due to unforeseen circumstances, customers will receive either a full refund or the option to reschedule.
5. Subscriptions
Subscriptions are billed monthly and require a minimum commitment of 6 months.
Subscription payments are non-refundable.
Each billing cycle includes one 6-hour booking credit.
Unused credits may roll over while the subscription remains active.
Credits have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for refunds.
Cancelling the subscription before the minimum term does not remove the remaining payment obligation.
6. GM Services
Professional GM services may include additional fees.
Cancellations of GM services within 72 hours of the session may be non-refundable due to preparation time.
7. Children & Minors
Children under 12 must be accompanied by a responsible adult.
8. Amendments
Talecraft reserves the right to update these terms when necessary. The terms in effect at the time of booking apply to that booking.
